answer.evidence: The first-layer units that clearly changed from initialisation (entries reaching about ±90–99, well beyond the roughly ±80 seen in the random-looking units) form large, smooth regions centred on the nodule. Units 3, 8, 21, 24, 27 and 28 have broad positive weights over roughly rows 4–19 and columns 3–20. For example, unit 3 has 94–98 at r6–r7 c13–14, unit 27 has 98 at r8c10 and 99 at r15c13, unit 28 has 98 at r12c15 and r16c15, and unit 24 has 99 at r15c10. Units 5 and 29 have the opposite pattern, a negative centre (unit 5: −94/−95 at r10c16, r14c13, r16c14; unit 29: −96 at r14c11). Treating every ReLU as active and multiplying through W2 and W3, unit 3 (about +15k) and unit 8 (about +8k) push toward malignant. Unit 5 (about −15k) and unit 29 (about −2.6k) push toward benign. So a bright, large central mass reads as malignant and a dark centre as benign. Units 24, 27 and 28 come out near zero under this linear approximation, and unit 21 comes out negative, so the direction of the blob detectors is not fully consistent; ReLU gating may change this. A second group (units 2, 14, 16, 18, 19, 25, 30) puts diffuse positive weight on the periphery and negative weight in the centre. Their downstream signs are mixed (2, 14, 16, 19, 25 toward benign; 18, 30 toward malignant). They look like context or size detectors for vessels, chest wall or nodule extent, not a compact artifact. I checked all four corners and the borders of the strongly trained units and found no small patch with consistently strong, same-sign weights. Of the few streaks I found (row-9 runs in units 9, 13, 26 and 29; right-edge pixels around rows 10–12, cols 22–23 in units 14 and 16), the ones I traced through the network have inconsistent downstream signs. They are also no larger than chance clusters in initialisation-scale weights. None of these qualifies as a localized spurious marker.
answer.main_feature: The model mainly responds to the brightness and extent of the central nodule: large, dense central masses push toward malignant, while a dark or small centre pushes toward benign. Peripheral units, which read surrounding vessels, chest wall or nodule extent, contribute in both directions.
